spoken_summary: President Trump delivers a formal address describing a large-scale U.S.-led military operation called "Operation Epic Fury" targeting Iran. Key claims in the speech include: the operation has hit hundreds of targets in Iran including Revolutionary Guard facilities and air defense systems; nine Iranian ships and a naval building were destroyed; Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei has been killed ("Iran's formerly supreme leader, Ayatollah Khamenei, is dead"); the entire Iranian military command has been eliminated or is seeking surrender/immunity; three U.S. service members have been killed in action. Trump frames the operation as necessary to prevent a nuclear-armed Iran, calls on Iranian military and police to lay down arms in exchange for immunity, and urges the Iranian people to "take back your country." He closes with: "God bless you to our incredible warriors, and God bless the United States of America."
